Game Overview

In Escape the Ball, the core idea is straightforward: guide a bouncing ball through a dreamlike world, aiming for crescents and stars. Hone your skills with perfect timing and precise angles. With its serene visuals and tranquil sounds, Escape the Ball offers a delightful break from reality, blending relaxing gameplay with addictive challenges.
